dimensions.assessment: Affects small businesses seeking surety bonds, participating sureties, the Small Business Administration, and congressional committees.
Significantly increases the maximum bond guarantee limit and imposes new reporting and administrative caps on the SBA program.
dimensions.evidence: Not more than 2 percent of the amount in the fund described in subsection (a)... may be obligated during that fiscal year to cover costs incurred by the Administration

dimensions.assessment: Alters revolving fund management, permits administrative expense obligations up to 2 percent, and sets conditions for supplemental funding requests.
dimensions.evidence: Not more than 2 percent of the amount in the fund... may be obligated... to cover costs incurred by the Administration in connection with the management and administration

dimensions.assessment: Amends the Small Business Investment Act of 1958 by expanding program limits, adding administrative rules, and mandating SBA and GAO reports.
dimensions.evidence: Part B of title IV of the Small Business Investment Act of 1958 (15 U.S.C. 694a et seq.) is amended

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory expansion of the surety bond program alongside ongoing annual and one-time reporting mandates.

missing_information: Total projected financial cost or net change in federal liability resulting from the increase of the bond guarantee threshold to $18 million.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill expands the Small Business Administration's surety bond program by increasing guarantee limits, setting administrative cost caps, and establishing new reporting requirements.
